task: Reconcile GitHub PR identity after parent closure force-with-lease refresh using bounded fail-closed read-after-write convergence and exact expected/observed diagnostics.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #312 attempt 2, triggered from immutable rehearsal source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65, failed at immediate parent closure PR identity verification: RELEASE_PARENT_CLOSURE_PR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH. The refreshed PR #1138 now has exact HEAD dcc450715b9a5dd6690be98017f9f98911b96805 and base c8b1897fc34bd8b867e9fa3e6e136f2ea6039308, but the executor checked the GitHub REST PR before these values were conclusively observed. The actual mismatched field was not recorded. Require bounded read-after-write reconciliation and machine-readable diagnostics while preserving full exact identity checks.
observableOutcomes: After the executor pushes a refreshed closure commit, the PR binding is accepted only when a fresh GitHub GET returns open, correct head ref, exact pushed head SHA, main base ref and exact final-main base SHA.
Initial stale head or stale base observations are retried for a bounded period and never authorized by time alone.
After bounded retries, the failure includes stable machine-readable exact expected and actual PR identity fields and retry count.
Unknown, foreign, moved, closed or persistently stale PR identities remain BLOCK; fail closed without releasing state or advancing closure.
Successful reconciliation still requires exact CI dispatch, fresh closure PR CI, merge lease, canonical CLOSED parent receipt and no duplicate U01/U02/U03 operations.
unresolvedRisks: GitHub API read-after-write might expose stale fields or a PR base SHA lag; this is a hypothesis until exact observed fields and retry evidence are persisted.
While polling, a foreign actor might mutate the PR or main; only precise final identity can authorize persistence.
Rerun reprojects the closure branch with a newly created commit; concurrent GitHub workflows must be checked before execution.

in: Add bounded, deterministic, exact PR identity verification after a closure branch force-with-lease push.
Always fetch an authoritative fresh numbered PR resource; do not rely on stale list result for acceptance.
Validate open state, exact ref names, exact head SHA and exact final-main base SHA simultaneously.
Emit machine-readable expected/actual PR identity with bounded read count on timeout and preserve the original failure code.
Add executable regression tests using injected GitHub response sequences and no-op wait to cover initial match, delayed match, wrong ref/head/base, closed state and expiry.
out: No weakening of exact SHA checks, Plan, Edit-Time, Completion Truth, Lifecycle, Sentinel, CI or receipt requirements.
No changes to immutable source plan, U01/U02/U03 receipts, canonical release-state branch, existing parent closure PR data, workflow permissions, Builder, Template or Storefront.
No external PR update, forced approval or manual state overwrite to disguise failed reconciliation.
No indefinite retry, blind 200-response acceptance or stale CI authorization.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Critical parent closure PR binding is a release authority boundary; asynchronous remote observation must remain exact and bounded with falsifiable negative tests and machine-readable diagnostics.

acceptanceCriteria: The plan-only commit passes canonical Plan Before Code before implementation.
A PR response that immediately matches all fields is accepted without retry delay.
One or more stale head/base observations may converge but only an exact subsequent numbered PR GET can pass.
An incorrect, closed, foreign or persistently stale PR is never accepted.
On expiry, the executor raises RELEASE_PARENT_CLOSURE_PR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH with JSON diagnostics identifying expected and observed state, refs, SHAs and number of reads.
Retry is limited to at most eight read attempts with an injected wait callback for deterministic tests.
GitHub PR detection and creation semantics are not broadened, and the existing force-with-lease branch update stays mandatory.
Exactly the latest closure HEAD, correct base main SHA, fresh closure CI and receipt-bound parent Lifecycle/Truth remain required before closure.
Main CI exact-head SUCCESS precedes immutable replay, followed by an actual canonical CLOSED receipt and U01-U03 preserved.
invariants: Any new GitHub PR head/base drift is a block unless it converges to the original executor-bound exact values during the bounded window.
Closure commit HEAD remains distinct from final implementation main and has independent evidence.
Neither the immutable source nor canonical state is manually mutated.
Only legitimate proved closure state transitions update canonical state.
Diagnostic fields do not include secrets or tokens.

failureModes: GitHub pull request list returns previous head immediately after force-with-lease push.
Follow-up PR detail read returns stale base main SHA for a short period.
PR state changes to closed during reconciliation.
Remote PR head unexpectedly changes to a foreign SHA.
Remote PR base ref targets another branch.
All attempts return stale values and the executor must fail closed with exact diagnostics.
edgeCases: First two responses contain old head, third response matches.
Head matches but base SHA lags then converges.
PR base ref permanently not main.
Proof head/ref correct but PR number unexpected.
All eight reads disagree and no merge/CI dispatch occurs.

alternatives.reason: Could persist closure against unproven final implementation main.

alternatives.reason: Still lacks falsifiable identity evidence and may fail with slow GitHub indexing.

specialistReviews.finding: The failure code masks which PR field disagreed after force-with-lease, so eventual consistency is not conclusively proven.
specialistReviews.resolution: Introduce bounded exact re-fetch and structured expected/actual diagnostics before allowing any persistence.

specialistReviews.finding: A retry window must not accept an unexpected SHA or PR target branch.
specialistReviews.resolution: Every read checks all immutable expected fields; only simultaneous exact match PASS.

specialistReviews.finding: The state remained old PR_OPEN even though GitHub branch moved; false commitment would corrupt truth.
specialistReviews.resolution: Retain no canonical state update until exact PR identity; preserve existing CAS and force-with-lease semantics.

specialistReviews.finding: PR #1138 #9213 returned action_required rather than a release authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Do not treat pull_request action_required as CI success; executor will require fresh workflow_dispatch CI.

specialistReviews.finding: New reproducible blocking machine error in executor with inadequate field-level diagnostics.
specialistReviews.resolution: Record Failure Intake issue #1141 and add adversarial regression coverage.

challenge.finding: Could authorize closure against unproven main.
challenge.resolution: Always verify base SHA and ref.

challenge.finding: Hung executor and indefinite release authority ambiguity.
challenge.resolution: Cap retries and produce expiry code.

challenge.resolution: Every iteration fetches and validates exact identity.

challenge.resolution: Require exact branch/ref and state on every read.

challenge.resolution: Closed PR remains BLOCK without CI dispatch.

challenge.resolution: Inject wait callback with no-op under tests; default runner bounded.

proofPlan: Commit this plan alone; require exact Plan Before Code PASS before editing code.
Add a testable exact PR identity predicate with all required state/ref/SHA comparisons.
Add a bounded read-after-write reconciliation function that re-GETs the numbered PR and never uses stale list data to PASS.
At expiry, emit RELEASE_PARENT_CLOSURE_PR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH with stable machine-readable expected/actual/read-count diagnostics.
Preserve existing GitHub branch force-with-lease update, PR discovery and exact CI dispatch behavior.
Add adversarial tests with injected PR response series and deterministic wait for immediate PASS, delayed convergence, stale head/base, changed ref/closed state and terminal expiry.
Prove Plan, Edit-Time, Known Failure replay, Quality, TypeScript, Production build and Completion Truth on the exact implementation HEAD.
Commit the closure lifecycle candidate from the verified implementation HEAD and require exact PR-head CI SUCCESS.
Merge hardening only after fresh PR CI and require post-merge main CI SUCCESS.
Replay the unmodified immutable source; prove parent PR exact-head CI, merge, canonical CLOSED state and no duplicate release-unit receipts; route any new blocker to Failure Intake.

requirements.requirement: The trusted executor must bind the parent closure PR after force-with-lease to a fresh exact remote identity or fail closed with structured proof on expiry.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A stale head/base ref cannot authorize a closure PR.
Remote PR identity failure cannot cause unbounded retries.
An exhausted identity mismatch must report the exact expected/observed fields.

notes: Incident recorded in Failure Intake #1141. Immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 unchanged; U01/U02/U03 CLOSED. Live executor #312 attempt 2 reprojected PR #1138 to closure HEAD dcc450715b9a5dd6690be98017f9f98911b96805 based on main c8b1897fc34bd8b867e9fa3e6e136f2ea6039308, but failed immediate post-push PR identity check. GitHub PR now shows matching refs/SHA; exact failing field unknown because old error lacked structured details. New proof only adds bounded re-fetch and full diagnostics. Plan Before Code #9215 explicitly measured the canonical projected failure corpus (19) and guardDigest 128614ad; updated expectation and replaced an underspecified forbidden state with a falsifiable negative proof condition.
